text:
sam_sales: LumenWorks procurement pinged — they want an assurance bundle for the POC: SOC 2 Type II PDF (redacted ok), ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation, KMS key handling statement, and a short network diagram. Need by next Wed COB. Can we deliver?

maria_security: We can assemble SOC2 + ISO cert quickly (PDFs). For the pen-test they explicitly asked if the letter can be notarized or if an e-signature suffices. Also they asked for a short KMS statement: key ownership, rotation cadence, and whether customer-managed keys can be supported for Private.

kevin_legal: Legal can sign the attestation. Notarization adds ~3 business days and a fee; e-signature (DocuSign) is standard and should be acceptable for procurement in most banks. If they insist on notarization we need their signatory name and jurisdiction to route to our notary partner.

rachel_ops: Operational note: if they request external scans against the POC env we need an ops runbook and pre-approved IP ranges. Also, customer-managed KMS for Private requires additional onboarding and may affect timeline/cost. If they only need a statement (not actual KMS setup), we can provide that immediately.

sam_sales: They said "notarized preferred but e-sign is acceptable". They also want a one-paragraph note from engineering about isolation options + a delta on pricing if we spin up a short-lived dedicated pool for the POC.

maria_security: Draft pen-test wording proposal:

```
Redwood Inference, Inc. attests that third-party penetration testing is performed at least annually against production and periodic scoped tests are performed against staging/dedicated environments upon customer request. As of (DATE), no critical vulnerabilities related to Redwood's hosted inference service were outstanding. A redacted summary of the latest external assessment (CVSS buckets only) can be provided upon NDA.
```

maria_security: We can add a KMS snippet:

```
Key management: Redwood stores customer data encrypted at rest using AES-256. Keys are managed in AWS KMS; rotation occurs every 365 days. For Redwood Private deployments, customers may supply/bring their own CMK.
```

kevin_legal: I'll review and convert to a signed attestation template. If procurement needs the signatory block to include specific corporate address or signer's title, let me know. Legal signs as "Redwood Inference, Inc."; signatory is the General Counsel by default.

rachel_ops: Pricing delta rough: short-lived dedicated pool (1 x A10-equivalent) for 2 weeks = +$3,800. Isolation + ephemeral IPs + ops window coordination may add one-off engineering time (estimate 4 hours). If they want customer-managed KMS or on-prem Private: separate quote.

sam_sales: Can someone prepare the network diagram (high-level) and a short engineering note we can drop into the vendor packet? They want to include it with the SOC/ISO docs.

maria_security: I'll hand off a redacted SOC2 + ISO cert and draft the attestation. Also preparing a redacted vuln summary (counts by CVSS) — no raw findings.

rachel_ops: For scan uploads we'll create a presigned S3 path. Example upload command we'll give them:

```
aws s3 cp their-scan.zip "<presigned-url>" --region us-west-2
```

rachel_ops: We'll need them to sign the scanning rules & scope form before we open ports. I can provision 3 candidate windows (Mon/Wed/Fri evenings) after approvals.

devops-bot: TICKET-5678 created: "lumenworks poc assurance & notarized attestation request" assigned to security/legal/ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/TICKET-5678

sam_sales: Action list: (1) Maria: attach SOC2 redacted + ISO cert and draft attestation, (2) Kevin: confirm signature approach and prepare DocuSign or notarization path, (3) Rachel: presigned S3 + scan windows + high-level network diagram, (4) Ops: provide pricing delta confirm and note any SLA impacts. Target: compile packet by Wed COB.

maria_security: On it. Looping in kevin_legal for sign-off now. I'll mark anything that needs NDA.

kevin_legal: I'll prepare two versions of the attestation: e-sign ready and notarization-ready. If they choose notarization, we'll need contact details for notary processing.

sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll confirm with procurement whether e-sign is acceptable and ask for notarization details only if they insist. Will update in this thread. :pray:

devops-bot: Note: artifact storage bucket rw-evidence/lumenworks will be created when presigned URL request is approved (TICKET-5678).
